sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Let me try MOUSE on the colored blocks to see if they're interactive
# First, let me check the current state
seg = current_frame.segmentation

# Find block positions
blocks = {}
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] in ('R', 'b', 'N') and n['pixels'] == 16:
        b = n['boundary']
        r_min = min(p[0] for p in b)
        c_min = min(p[1] for p in b)
        blocks[n['color']] = (r_min, c_min)
print(f"Blocks: {blocks}")

# Try MOUSE on the Red block center
# Red block at r=13-16, c=42-45, center at (14.5, 43.5) -> row 14, col 43
action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 14, 'col': 43}])

seg = current_frame.segmentation
print("\n=== AFTER MOUSE on Red ===")
# Check if anything changed
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] in ('R', 'b', 'N', 'M', 'g', 'G') and n['pixels'] <= 20:
        b = n['boundary']
        r_min = min(p[0] for p in b)
        if r_min < 50:
            c_min = min(p[1] for p in b)
            c_max = max(p[1] for p in b)
            r_max = max(p[0] for p in b)
            if n['pixels'] <= 8 or n['color'] in ('R', 'b', 'N', 'M'):
                print(f"  {n['color']}: r={r_min}-{r_max}, c={c_min}-{c_max}, px={n['pixels']}")

# Check left strip
print("\n=== LEFT STRIP ===")
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] in ('g', 'G') and 14 <= min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']) <= 40:
        b = n['boundary']
        r_min = min(p[0] for p in b)
        r_max = max(p[0] for p in b)
        if n['pixels'] <= 8:
            print(f"  {n['color']}: r={r_min}-{r_max}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
